cust-103.address: King Fahd Rd, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia

ROPA.name: Platform access and authentication
ROPA.purpose: Authenticate users, enforce MFA and protect accounts against takeover
ROPA.basis: Art. 6(1)(b) contract; Art. 6(1)(f) legitimate interest in security
ROPA.subjects: Customer staff, auditors, vendor contacts, Trust Center visitors
ROPA.data: Name, work email, role, MFA method, sign-in time, IP address and device
ROPA.transfers: None outside the pinned data region
ROPA.retention: Account life plus 12 months; security logs 7 years
ROPA.tom: MFA, passkeys, rate limiting, session timeouts, hash-chained log

ROPA.name: User, role and access administration
ROPA.purpose: Manage who can use the workspace and with which permissions; access requests and reviews
ROPA.basis: Art. 6(1)(b) contract; Art. 6(1)(c) legal obligation (access control duties)
ROPA.data: Name, email, job title, role, application accounts, access decisions
ROPA.transfers: None outside the pinned data region
ROPA.tom: Least privilege, four-eyes approvals, quarterly reviews

ROPA.name: Personnel security compliance
ROPA.purpose: Track onboarding tasks, training, background checks, devices and offboarding as control evidence
ROPA.basis: Art. 6(1)(c) legal obligation; Art. 6(1)(f) legitimate interest in information security
ROPA.data: Name, department, start and end dates, training records, device posture, check outcome (not the report)
ROPA.transfers: Per connector contract; SCCs or IDTA where outside the region
ROPA.retention: Employment plus 6 years (sample, set per policy)
ROPA.tom: Role-based visibility, sensitive fields restricted to admins

ROPA.name: Compliance evidence and document management
ROPA.purpose: Collect, approve and retain evidence that controls operate
ROPA.basis: Art. 6(1)(c) legal obligation; Art. 6(1)(f) legitimate interest in demonstrating compliance
ROPA.data: Files that may contain names, signatures and business contact data (metadata removed on upload)
ROPA.recipients: External auditors during an audit window
ROPA.transfers: None outside the pinned data region
ROPA.tom: Content checks, metadata removal, AES-256-GCM encryption, SHA-256 integrity

ROPA.name: Policy management and acknowledgement
ROPA.purpose: Write, approve and publish policies and record staff acceptance
ROPA.basis: Art. 6(1)(c) legal obligation; Art. 6(1)(b) employment contract
ROPA.data: Name, acceptance date, remarks, approval decisions
ROPA.tom: Sequential approval, version history, owner-only editing

ROPA.name: Risk management and ISO/IEC 27005 register
ROPA.purpose: Identify, assess, treat and accept information security risks
ROPA.basis: Art. 6(1)(c) legal obligation; Art. 6(1)(f) legitimate interest
ROPA.data: Names of owners and approvers, decisions, acceptance rationale

ROPA.name: Third-party and vendor risk management
ROPA.purpose: Assess suppliers, collect questionnaires and evidence, monitor them
ROPA.basis: Art. 6(1)(c) legal obligation (outsourcing rules); Art. 6(1)(f) legitimate interest
ROPA.subjects: Vendor contacts, internal requesters and owners
ROPA.data: Vendor contact names and emails, questionnaire answers, certificates
ROPA.transfers: Vendor locations vary; SCCs or IDTA required
ROPA.tom: Vendor portal isolation, encrypted uploads, gated approvals

ROPA.name: Audit support and auditor collaboration
ROPA.purpose: Run internal and external audits, share evidence with auditors under time-bound access
ROPA.basis: Art. 6(1)(c) legal obligation; Art. 6(1)(f) legitimate interest
ROPA.subjects: Auditors, evidence owners, staff in sampled populations
ROPA.data: Auditor contact data, populations (names, dates), findings
ROPA.recipients: Audit firm (independent controller for its working papers)
ROPA.tom: Audit-window access, controlled population views, auto-revocation

ROPA.name: Trust Center and customer assurance
ROPA.purpose: Share security documents with prospects and customers under NDA
ROPA.basis: Art. 6(1)(b) steps prior to contract; Art. 6(1)(f) legitimate interest
ROPA.data: Name, work email, company, NDA acceptance, document access log
ROPA.retention: 24 months after last access; erasure on request

ROPA.name: Customer questionnaires and contract commitments
ROPA.purpose: Answer customer security questionnaires and track contractual obligations

ROPA.name: AI-assisted processing and AI governance
ROPA.purpose: Draft answers and suggestions with AI; govern AI systems under ISO/IEC 42001 and the EU AI Act
ROPA.basis: Art. 6(1)(f) legitimate interest; human approval before any effect (Art. 22 safeguards)
ROPA.subjects: Users whose prompts or records are processed
ROPA.data: Prompts, workspace records in scope of the request, outputs
ROPA.recipients: Named model provider (sub-processor), no training on customer data
ROPA.tom: Company AI switch, read-only agents, draft-only output, logging

ROPA.name: Incident and personal data breach management
ROPA.purpose: Record incidents, assess breaches and meet notification deadlines (GDPR Art. 33 and 34, contracts)
ROPA.data: Incident facts, affected categories, notification records
ROPA.recipients: Supervisory authority, affected customers where required
ROPA.tom: Incident clock, notice records, access restriction

ROPA.name: Data subject rights handling
ROPA.purpose: Handle access, erasure and objection requests

ROPA.name: Continuous monitoring and integrations
ROPA.purpose: Sync cloud, identity, HR and code systems to test controls automatically
ROPA.basis: Art. 6(1)(f) legitimate interest in security assurance
ROPA.subjects: Employees with accounts in connected systems
ROPA.data: Account names, emails, MFA status, device and repository metadata
ROPA.transfers: Per connector; SCCs where outside the region
ROPA.retention: Latest state plus 13 months of results
ROPA.tom: Read-only scopes, per-tenant vault, hourly full-state sync

ROPA.name: Security logging and evidence preservation
ROPA.purpose: Keep a tamper-evident record of actions for security monitoring, audit and legal claims
ROPA.basis: Art. 6(1)(c) legal obligation; Art. 6(1)(f) legitimate interest
ROPA.data: User ID, name, role, action, result, time, IP and device placeholder, record references
ROPA.recipients: Auditors and authorities on lawful request
ROPA.transfers: None outside the pinned data region
ROPA.tom: Append-only hash chain per tenant, verification, signed exports

ROPA.name: Customer billing and account management
ROPA.purpose: Invoice subscriptions by module and usage, collect payment, keep accounting records
ROPA.basis: Art. 6(1)(b) contract; Art. 6(1)(c) legal obligation (tax and accounting)
ROPA.data: Name, billing email, company, tax ID, invoices, payment references (no card data)
ROPA.recipients: Payment processor (Clearwater Payments), email delivery provider, tax authorities
ROPA.transfers: Clearwater Payments (US) under SCCs or IDTA
ROPA.retention: 6 years after the financial year (UK), longest local rule applies
ROPA.tom: Card data held only by the payment processor, invoice integrity hash

ROPA.name: Tenant administration and support
ROPA.purpose: Onboard customers, manage entitlements and handle support such as MFA resets
ROPA.data: Admin name, email, ticket references, identity check results
ROPA.tom: Two super admins for MFA resets, no access to customer content
